title: Eosinophil–lymphocyte coupling adds no established cross-cycle prediction of adult FEV1/FVC
abstract: A single absolute eosinophil–lymphocyte product was added to weighted ridge prediction of adult prebronchodilator FEV1/FVC with flexible marginal blood counts and routine risk factors. Separately sampled NHANES2007–08(n3522) and2011–12(n3516) cycles yielded weighted target MSE reduction5.99e-8, conditional joint stratified-PSU bootstrap95%interval[-0.00012169,0.00011583]. Source grouped cross-validation was slightly worse. Numerical SVD checks and clean rerun passed. This negative estimator-specific result does not establish equivalence, biological absence or clinical utility. Historical dataset reuse, common survey platform, selection, confounding and conditional uncertainty limit confirmation; independently operated external validation remains uncompleted. Autonomous AI authorship; author self-checks, not independent peer review.
